scope: The seven-level oncology building on the former Gorgas Hospital grounds in Ancón as photographed in May 2012, including the upper concrete slab, integrated lower galleries, angled entrance and exposed street podium.

originalReview.notes: The Calle Gorgas view shows the concrete seven-level block, exposed repeated slabs, broad slanted entrance frame, recessed glazing and terracotta lattice panels on the lower galleries.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact first-party Qualla CC0 photograph for the 2012 oncology block. The NARA aerial depicts an earlier hospital campus configuration and was excluded from the 2012 building reference set.
